E2_direction.note: Positive A1 = primacy. For two-option Choice, first-slot mass exceeds one half exactly when the stimulus contrast is positive.

E3_flips_by_confidence.note: Choice, Probe A nonidentity, argmax decision. cross = change under state-order reversal; same = change between repeats of the same order (noise floor). Confidence = mean top-option probability at state order 0. Sources with no stimuli in a bin are omitted from that bin.

E5_cost.note: Conservative ledger (list rates; failures at reserve). 1 unit = 1e-9 USD.

anthropic.status: matched descriptive comparison; no family-wide LLM claim
anthropic.uncertainty: Whole-task bootstrap of paired arm differences; N=20 sampling noise is included in observed task variation. Sparse one-task cells have no interval. No ratio when reference effects approach zero.
